attempts.cause: T008_INVOICE_PKG.apply_payment does not correctly handle the case where payment is exactly equal to open amount, and T008_PAYMENTS_API does not catch the exception raised by T008_INVOICE_PKG when payment exceeds open amount.
T008_PAYMENTS_API does not catch the application error raised by T008_INVOICE_PKG when payment exceeds open amount, leading to the function returning 'PAID' instead of 'REJECTED'.
T008_PAYMENTS_API is not catching the application error raised by T008_INVOICE_PKG because the exception name/number used in the package body does not match the one raised by T008_INVOICE_PKG.
